text: As the plaza grew quieter, Leo felt more familiar with the rhythm of the conversations around him.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: How are things going, Leo? Are you beginning to understand the conversations around the plaza?

speaker: Mang Ben
text: That's a good start! You don't have to understand everything right away. Listening and practice will help. Would you like to keep practicing together?

speaker: Mang Ben
text: That's all right. When a conversation is hard to follow, you can ask the other person to sign SLOW. Would you like me to slow down now?
As evening settled over the plaza, Leo realized that confusion was part of learning. Asking for help, listening, and trying again would help him improve.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Great! Keep practicing, and you'll understand more each time.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: No problem. Take your time; I'm here if you need help.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: Of course. I'll slow down so it's easier to follow.

speaker: Mang Ben
text: All right. We'll continue at this pace, but you can ask me to slow down anytime.
